newsitem.title: CHINA: Matsuo Bridge to open plant in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Matsuo Bridge to open plant in Shanghai.

text.p: Matsuo Bridge 5913.T) has started building a plant in Shanghai's Pudong New Area to make steel products for use in construction, bridge-making and power stations, official newspapers said on Saturday.

Shanghai Matsuo Bridge Steel Structure Co Ltd is wholly owned by Matsuo Bridge and involves a total investment of $30 million, the Liberation Daily said. The Japanese firm will introduce state-of-the-art manufacturing technology, it said.
The plant will produce 3,000 tonnes of steel products annually. Matsuo Bridge is the 1,775th Japanese company to invest in Shanghai, Business News said but gave no more details.
